contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy coin. Nummus of the House of Constantine (306-361), Gloria Exercitus issue of 330-335 on a small flan, probably irregular, Reece period 17. Obverse description: Head diademed right. Obverse inscription: [looks like] IVI[--]. Reverse description: two soldiers with two standards between them; triangular tops to standards. Reverse inscription: [GLORIA EXERC]ITVS. Diameter: 13mm, Weight: 1.03gms, die axis: 5
